templates.name: API Access Agreement
templates.description: A commercial agreement to buy and use an API: the buyer's agent and the API provider agree pricing, rate limits, SLA and payment (x402). This is API commerce — not a delegation of authority.

buyer_name.description: Legal name of the API consumer / principal

seller_name.description: Legal name of the API provider

x402_enabled.description: Whether x402 HTTP payment protocol is used

buyer_agent_id.description: Wallet address of the agent consuming the API

price_per_call.description: Cost per API call in specified currency (for per-call model)

seller_agent_id.description: Wallet address of the provider agent (if agent-to-agent)

sla_response_ms.description: Maximum p95 response time in milliseconds

data_retention_days.description: How long request/response data is retained

data_processing_location.description: Geographic restriction on data processing (e.g. EU, US)

templates.name: Compute & Data Processing SLA
templates.description: Service-level agreement for ongoing compute, infrastructure, or data processing. Covers performance guarantees, auto-scaling, GDPR data handling, and breach remedies.

client_name.description: Legal name of the client entity

monthly_fee.description: Base monthly fee in specified currency

provider_name.description: Legal name of the service provider

client_agent_id.description: Wallet address of the client agent

provider_agent_id.description: Wallet address of the provider agent

service_description.description: Detailed description of compute/data services provided

breach_credit_percent.description: Service credit percentage per SLA breach incident

max_scaling_multiplier.description: Maximum auto-scale factor (e.g. 2x = up to double base resources)

data_processing_location.description: GDPR: geographic restriction on data processing

data_deletion_on_termination.description: Whether provider deletes all client data on contract end

templates.name: Task Execution Agreement
templates.description: Agent-to-agent or principal-to-agent task contract with defined deliverables, acceptance criteria, and payment on completion. For one-off or milestone-based work.

ip_ownership.description: Who owns intellectual property of the deliverables

executor_name.description: Legal name of the executing party / provider

requester_name.description: Legal name of the requesting party / principal

task_description.description: Detailed description of the task to be performed

executor_agent_id.description: Wallet address of the executor agent

requester_agent_id.description: Wallet address of the requester agent

acceptance_criteria.description: How completion and quality will be verified

templates.name: Service Purchase Agreement (Agent-to-Consumer)
templates.description: An AI agent sells a defined service to a human consumer — covers scope, fees, delivery timeline, refund policy, and mandatory cooling-off period. Compliant with EU Consumer Rights Directive 2011/83/EU, UETA s. 14, and eIDAS Art. 25. Includes EU AI Act Art. 50 transparency disclosure.

consumer_name.description: Full legal name of the consumer

provider_name.description: Legal name of entity behind the AI agent

consumer_email.description: Consumer email for signing via Privy/magic-link

agent_disclosure.default: This contract is generated and administered by an AI agent.

templates.name: AI-Driven Subscription Agreement
templates.description: Consumer subscribes to an AI-mediated service with recurring billing — covers monthly fee, SLA, cancellation, auto-renewal controls, and mandatory cooling-off. Compliant with EU Consumer Rights Directive, UETA s. 14, eIDAS Art. 25.

templates.name: AI Agent Warranty and Liability Agreement
templates.description: AI agent commits to a guaranteed service outcome with enforceable liability caps and remedies. Covers warranty scope, liability limits, claim procedures, and arbitration. Consumer may reject arbitration for small claims court. UCTA-compliant.

templates.name: Power of Attorney
templates.description: One-sided power of attorney: you sign once and it activates immediately — the fastest way to authorize your own AI agent, with no second signature to chase. A single cNFT mints to you as proof. Optional spending caps.

agent_id.description: AI agent wallet receives authority but does NOT sign

templates.name: General Agent Authorization
templates.description: Two-sided delegation: you and your AI agent each sign, so the agent holds its own on-chain proof it may act for you — useful when it must show that authority to a third party. Covers action categories, spending caps and revocation. Structured with reference to UETA s. 14 (US) and eIDAS Art. 25 (EU).

scope.description: Natural language description of authorized actions

agent_id.description: Agent wallet address (0x...) or platform identifier

categories.description: Approved action categories (e.g. procurement, data-queries, api-calls)

principal_name.description: Full legal name of the delegating entity or individual

principal_type.description: Legal entity type of the principal

spending_limit_per_tx.description: Maximum spend per single transaction in USD

spending_limit_monthly.description: Maximum aggregate monthly spend in USD

sub_delegation_allowed.description: Whether agent may delegate to sub-agents

requires_approval_above.description: Transaction threshold requiring separate principal approval

revocation_notice_hours.description: Hours of notice required for revocation

principal_registration_number.description: Company registration number, personal code, or EIN

templates.name: Multi-Agent Fleet Authorization
templates.description: Authorize a class of AI agents under a lead agent, with shared budget pool, escalation thresholds, and sub-delegation rules. For organizations running multiple coordinated agents.

agent_class.description: Class identifier for authorized sub-agents (e.g. procurement-bot-v2)

lead_agent_id.description: Wallet address of the lead/orchestrator agent

principal_name.description: Full legal name of the delegating entity

permitted_actions.description: Actions any fleet agent may perform

audit_log_required.description: Whether all sub-agent actions must be logged

per_agent_tx_limit.description: Maximum single transaction for any individual agent

restricted_actions.description: Actions reserved for lead agent only

escalation_threshold.description: Transaction value above which lead agent must approve

shared_budget_monthly.description: Total monthly budget shared across the fleet in USD

templates.name: Limited Service Agent
templates.description: Time-bounded, task-specific delegation for a single service engagement. Fixed budget, narrow scope, automatic expiry. Suitable for one-off agent deployments.

end_date.description: ISO 8601 date when authority automatically expires

budget_usd.description: Total fixed budget for the engagement in USD

principal_name.description: Full legal name of the delegating entity

service_description.description: Specific service the agent is authorized to perform

permitted_counterparties.description: Specific entities the agent may transact with (empty = any)

principal_registration_number.description: Company registration or personal identification number
